final_answer: Kurt Cobain died by suicide on April 5, 1994, in Seattle, Washington. He was found dead in his home with a self-inflicted gunshot wound to the head. The cause of death was officially ruled as a suicide by hanging, although some have raised questions about the official cause of death. (Source: Wikipedia)
